nodes.label: PostgreSQL syllabus
nodes.rationale: 14 phases, 233 topics in 4 parts. Relational model, SQL, planner, concurrency, ops, plus Node-side raw pg. Verified 2026-08 against PostgreSQL 18.4.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL example policy
nodes.rationale: Every page carries SQL or shell and the Node pg code that issues it. A psql-only page is incomplete for Phases 2–13. Real output, not plausible-looking.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL 18.4 target
nodes.rationale: Server and psql 18.4, pg on Node 24, postgres:18-alpine on 127.0.0.1:55432 never localhost. Node Phase 6/7 pages were measured on 17.10 — re-check version-sensitive links.

nodes.label: Recap rule with Node Phase 6
nodes.rationale: Pool sizing, transaction propagation, N+1, repository rationale, ORM comparison belong to Node 6. PG Part 3 recaps ≤40 lines and links; it does not re-own those pages.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL tier distribution
nodes.rationale: Master 62 (27%), Understand 127 (54%), Know 35 (15%), When Needed 9 (4%). Master by part: 20 / 14 / 14 / 14.
